name: bridge_tower
notes: The gothic gate tower at the shore end of a bridge: a dark sandstone block 12 x 13 m across its corner turrets and 34 m high, with a pointed gate through it along Z under a carved tympanum and a coat of arms, a band of blind arcading, three traceried windows a side, a pierced-parapet gallery under a steep slate pyramid roof, and four crocketed turrets. Front faces -Z.
